ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://citl.illinois.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Priority registration will be given to FSHN MS Online degree seeking students. Pending seating availability, registration for non-degree seeking can be added to a waitlist. Please contact: Christine Martinez (cmartinz@illinois.edu). This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the CITL offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees. For ProctorU technical specifications and additional information visit: http://www.ao.uiuc.edu/support/source/student_services/proctoru_tech.html.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $394.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
